displayTitle: The Clone Wars Ultimate Battles Sticker Collection
synopsis: Junior Jedi's will love this comprehensive ultimate battles sticker collection packed with 600 out-of-this-world stickers of characters, vehicles and weapons from the explosive Clone Wars battles. Watch as they create their own scenes and then peel the stickers off to use again and again. This is the perfect sticker collection for budding padawans and a brilliant addition to any Star Wars fans collection.
title: The Clone Wars Ultimate Battles Sticker Collection
